about.title: I got into this because I wanted to know how things actually break
about.bio:
I'm Mohammad Albaik, a cybersecurity specialist focused on defensive security and currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity at Jordan University of Science and Technology (JUST).

I'm constantly learning, building, breaking things, making mistakes, and learning from them. I believe real growth comes from curiosity, hands-on experience, and being willing to fail, understand why, and come back better.

Cybersecurity is more than just a field I'm studying — it's something I genuinely enjoy exploring, one challenge at a time.
